figurative_meaning_bn: খোলা ছাতার শিকের মত চারদিকে বা দূরেদূরে বিক্ষিপ্ত/বিস্তৃত
figurative_meaning_en: Scattered or spread out in all directions like the spokes of an open umbrella
example_sentences_in_english: The household items are scattered everywhere.
People have spread out all over the market.
note: The idiom draws from the visual of an open umbrella's structure, common in traditional Bengali imagery.
